symptoms: Numerous small circular spots (2-4 mm) with dark margins and gray/tan centers
Tiny black specks (pycnidia fruiting bodies) visible in lesion centers with a hand lens
Leaves turn yellow, wither, and fall off progressing from bottom upward
risk_factors: Moderate temperatures (20-25°C) with persistent wet foliage
Overcrowded planting beds with poor air circulation
prevention: Mulch soil to eliminate fungal spore rain splash
Rotate crops annually to non-solanaceous families
Clean all stakes and cages at the end of each growing season
recommended_actions: Prune infected bottom leaves as soon as circular gray spots appear
Apply protective chlorothalonil or copper-based fungicides
